correctedCritiques.pro-narrative-moral-limiting-cases: Strongest feature: The move applies the mediation objection to secular limiting cases, showing that descriptions of misery and flourishing organize experience through evaluative selection and construction. Principal limitation: The hell-and-heaven analogy does not establish that limiting cases function as religious narratives, or that presentation defeats the possibility that conscious experience supplies moral information. Live burden: The argument must identify the explanatory work performed by narrative form, show why secular concepts cannot reproduce it, and explain why resemblance to inherited imagery supports reliability rather than merely rhetorical vividness. Locked score: The strong competent band recognizes incisive contact, careful calibration, and an illuminating analogy, while preserving the crucial distinction between exposing an evaluative premise and defeating moral realism.
correctedCritiques.pro-rational-instruction-behavioral-limi: Strongest feature: The move distinguishes possessing an accurate explanation from successfully changing behavior, using interventions to challenge the assumption that reasoning automatically governs conduct. Principal limitation: It shifts the dispute from epistemic reliability to efficacy, because weak behavioral uptake does not establish whether inherited heuristics track causes, fail after environmental change, or retain authority. Live burden: The argument must offer evidence beyond sexual-education examples, explain how narrative practices outperform interventions, and integrate accurate causal understanding instead of treating motivational difficulty as support for inherited explanations. Locked score: The mixed band credits coherent behavioral insight and practical relevance, while recording limited warrant, reduced charity toward the opposing reliability distinction, and failure to contact the decisive causal objection.
